whyItMatters: Phoenix.HTML.raw writes unescaped markup in elixir, so untrusted input reaching it becomes cross-site scripting.
actions: Escape the value with Phoenix.HTML.html_escape or bind it as text content.
If raw markup is required, sanitize it against an allowlist of tags and attributes.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Phoenix.HTML.raw call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Phoenix.HTML.raw reachable from untrusted input, and markup probes render inert.
